curriculumOverview.title: Curriculum Overview
curriculumOverview.body: Our curriculum is designed to challenge, inspire, and support all learners. We focus on literacy, math, science, and social studies, while integrating critical thinking, problem-solving, and effective communication across all content areas.

studentLedActivities.title: Student Led Activities
studentLedActivities.intro: Student voice is central to our culture. Whether it is leading a station in gym class, helping plan a spirit week, or presenting a project to the school community, Segue scholars are empowered to lead with confidence.
studentLedActivities.listIntro: We provide structured opportunities for students to:
items: Design and teach mini-lessons
Host exhibitions or clubs
Collaborate on school improvement ideas
Mentor younger scholars
studentLedActivities.outro: These moments build ownership and agency, key skills for high school, college, and beyond.

afterSchoolEnrichment.title: After School Enrichment
afterSchoolEnrichment.intro: Our afterschool programs expand learning through curiosity-driven, hands-on experiences. Sessions change seasonally and include partnerships with beloved local organizations such as:

sections.heading: Roger Williams Zoo
items: K-1 students meet live animals and explore nature-based learning.

sections.heading: Farm Fresh RI
items: 3rd-4th graders learn healthy eating habits and cook with local produce.

sections.heading: Audubon Society
items: Brings animals and outdoor games to 5th-6th graders, encouraging environmental education.

sections.heading: Cheer and Soccer Clinics
items: Students practice leadership by teaching their classmates what they have learned.
Teamwork and communication
Confidence through movement
Goal-setting and leadership

afterSchoolEnrichment.outro: Each session is designed to be educational, engaging, and confidence-building. Scholars are encouraged to try new things, challenge themselves, and build friendships along the way.

afterSchoolPrograms.title: After School Programs
overviewItems: Our afterschool program provides hands-on, engaging experiences that extend learning beyond the classroom.
sessionOneItems: K-1st Grade: Partnered with Roger Williams Zoo to meet animals and integrate ELA/Math stations.
3rd-4th Grade: Explored healthy cooking with Farm Fresh Rhode Island.
5th-6th Grade: Learned about local wildlife through the Audubon Society; played scavenger hunts and outdoor games.
Enrichment Clinics: Cheer and Soccer students practiced new skills and taught them to classmates.
sessionTwoItems: Boxing Fundamentals with Mr. Powell focuses on strength, conditioning, and confidence.
Also reinforced through Falcon Fitness and Gym classes.

content: Health and wellness are woven into the Segue experience. Our physical education program includes
, a program built around endurance, strength, and self-discipline. Students participate in activities that build stamina, flexibility, and focus, guided by dedicated coaches and instructors.
class, for example, introduces upper-grade students to skills such as footwork, coordination, and mental toughness—lessons that carry over into the classroom and life beyond school.
Wellness also includes emotional balance. We encourage self-care, mindfulness breaks, and a culture of kindness that supports the whole child.

sections.title: Treat furniture, books, and library materials with care.
items: SIT on chairs, stools, and benches. Do not stand, lay, or jump on any furniture.
Be GENTLE with books. They are fragile.
Do NOT write, draw, or mark any furniture in the library.

sections.title: If you take a book off the shelf, return it to the BOOK DROP located at the circulation desk.
items: NEVER put a book back on the shelf. This disrupts the organization of the library and may mean you cannot find the book again.

sections.title: NO food or drinks are allowed in the library.
items: Water is OK in closed containers.

sections.title: Use only a quiet voice and have a calm body while in the library.
items: Whispers ONLY
Do NOT jump or stand on furniture
Walking feet

sections.title: Stay in scholar spaces
items: Scholars can read, work, or relax at the maker tables in the center of the room, or on either side of the circulation desk by the bookshelves.
Scholars are NOT allowed in the staff area, staff bathroom, or behind the circulation desk.

uniformPolicy.title: Uniform Policy
formalItems: Maroon Segue polo (short or long sleeve)
Black or khaki pants, shorts, or skirt
Leggings may be worn under skirts and shorts
Long-sleeve undershirts may be worn under polos in colder months
uniformPolicy.notAllowedText: jeans, hoodies, hats, Uggs, Crocs, open-toed shoes, sandals, slippers, heels, moccasins
peItems: Same prohibited items as formal uniform
